title: Ecco the Dolphin: Defender of the Future/The Gifts
text:
Power of Vigor 

With the Power of Vigor, Ecco's strength is augmented, and Ecco's swimming and charging abilities are increased. Ecco can push rocks, reach higher heights, and conquer swift currents. And Ecco's strengthened charge is almost unstoppable.

 Power of Air 

This temporarily gives Ecco more air so he can stay underwater for a longer period of time. However, inhaling more air during this time will not replenish his air meter.

 Power of Sonar 

With the Power of Sonar, Ecco can use his Sonar to attack enemies and can even use it to shatter some rocks and other objects to reveal hidden secrets or passageways.

 Power of Endurance 

This temporarily gives Ecco more health and strengthens his resistance to harm. However, eating more fish during this time will not replenish his health. 

 Power of Stealth 

The Power of Stealth turns Ecco invisible for a short time. This allows him to evade enemies and get past certain obstacles he will face.
